notes: VCA303 rework #3 (Buyer Due List carry-over): the diagonal 'Carry Over' stamp now OVERLAYS the last rows of a continued column (absolute, pointer-events:none) instead of occupying its own rows — plus (from v0.1.152) it's a darker 45° diagonal, multi-column buyers carry a part-number badge (1/2/3) on each banner (no தொடர்ச்சி/தொடர்கிறது text), and all of one buyer's columns stay on the same page.
